term: has will (ST I q.19; Lean parameter `HasWill` of `GodHasWill`)
definition: `HasWill g`: g has will in the sense of ST I q.19 a.1, the inclination that follows understanding. In stage 2 group 1 (#198) the predicate is opaque: CATHOLICISM-STAGE2-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES accepts any predicate under this name, so nothing proved there depends on its content.
note: Stage 2 group 3 (#201) gives it content for God through ST I q.19 a.1: whatever has intellect has will.
